widgets_values: Use <Video 1> for the same people, scene, framing and body motion. Follow the exact synchronized speech or singing content and timing of <Audio 1>. The visible active singer must articulate the words or lyrics in time with <Audio 1>. Preserve natural facial expression, blinks, head motion and identity. Do not invent extra words, extra singing, or unrelated mouth motion.
Interactive native-H3 lipsync diagnostic/shot workflow. Source video is converted to a silent Ref2VA video reference; vocals are the sole Audio 1 and timeline guide.

nodes.title: Lipsync test input
widgets_values: Use a short 5–8 s diagnostic clip first. `source_clip.mp4` and `vocals.wav` must represent the same absolute time range. The source video is rebuilt without its embedded soundtrack, so the standalone vocals remain deterministic `<Audio 1>`. For the clearest test use one visible singer, a medium/close face, and modest camera motion.

nodes.title: Native H3 lipsync path
widgets_values: `vocals.wav` is used twice on purpose: as the Ref2VA audio reference bound to `<Video 1>`, and as `MiniMaxH3AddGuide` at `frame_idx=0`. The saved QC MP4 remuxes the exact input vocals rather than H3-generated audio, so mouth timing is judged against the authoritative source waveform.

nodes.title: 0.4 MP diagnostic baseline
widgets_values: The graph follows the current F01 Ref2VA architecture: Generation Settings → AutoCondition + Sampling Preset → Model Optimizations → stock H3 sampling. Resolution starts at 0.4 MP / 32-aligned. Keep optimizations OFF for the first lipsync A/B; upscale only after articulation and identity are acceptable.
